### plotting the results

```{r}
winter_meta <- read_delim("input/feems/LOSH.feems_meta.csv",delim=",") %>% filter(group!="breeding")
rub_assignment<-read.xlsx("~/Desktop/LOSH/WGSAssign_results/LOSH.winter286.combined_subsetted.thin_10.assigned_pop.REF197B.wide_consistent.angsd.loco-pipe.wmeta.xlsx",sheet=1) %>% rename(sample_id=BGP_ID)
traj <- read_csv("output/feems/feems_LOSH_fst_second_T251/nonbreeding_assignment_summary.csv")  %>% left_join(winter_meta) %>% left_join(rub_assignment)
```

```{r}

world <- ne_countries(scale='medium',returnclass = 'sf')
class(world)
americas<- world %>% filter(region_wb %in% c("North America", "Latin America & Caribbean"))


results_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = americas, fill = "gray92", color = "gray60") +
  
  # Arrows from winter → breeding, colored by Basin
  geom_curve(
    data = traj,
    aes(
      x = capture_lon, y = capture_lat,
      xend = map_lon, yend = map_lat,
      color = Assignment,
      alpha = map_prob
    ),
    curvature = 0.2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  
  # Points for winter captures (colored by Basin)
  geom_point(
    data = traj,
    aes(x = capture_lon, y = capture_lat, color = Assignment),
    size = 1
  ) +
  
  # Points for predicted breeding locations (keep neutral green to distinguish)
  geom_point(
    data = traj,
    aes(x = map_lon, y = map_lat, color=Assignment),
    size = 1
  ) +
  
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-130, -60), ylim = c(10, 60)) +
  labs(
    title = "Winter to breeding origins using Fst",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    caption = "Arrows represent predicted breeding origin from FEEMS",
    color = "Assignment",
    alpha = "Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray85")
  )
results_plot
ggsave("fst_feems_NBorigin_plot.png")
```

## Read in genoscape 
```{r}
library(raster)  # important to load before tidyverse, otherwise it masks select()
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggspatial)
library(openxlsx)
library(genoscapeRtools)
library(tess3r)
genoscape_brick<-terra::rast("input/genoscape/LOSH.ind316.genoscape_brick.breedingK3.WGS84.tif")
names(genoscape_brick) <- c("grp1","grp2","grp3")

# AU- doesn't work
#genoscape_brick<-terra::rast("input/genoscape/losh_au_genoscape_brick.grd")
#names(genoscape_brick) <- c("grp1","grp2","grp3","grp4")

library(raster)
genoscape_brick_old <- raster::stack(genoscape_brick) 
genoscape_rgba <- genoscapeRtools::qprob_rando_raster(
  TRB = genoscape_brick_old,
  cols = cluster_colors, 
  alpha_scale = 2.2, 
  abs_thresh = 0.0, 
  alpha_exp = 1.8, 
  alpha_chop_max = 230,
  scale_min_to = 0
)
crs(genoscape_rgba) <- "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs +ellps=WGS84 +towgs84=0,0,0"

```



# at this point, we must be explicit about adding a projection to the raster.
# This adds the info for a regular lat-long projection
```{r}
coastlines <- st_read("~/Dropbox/BGP/genoscape_maps/shapefiles/ne_shapefiles/ne_10m_coastline.shp")
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
domain <- c(
  xmin = -182,
  xmax = -5,
  ymin = -10,
  ymax = 115
)

coast_cropped <- st_crop(coastlines, domain)
countries_cropped <-  st_read("~/Dropbox/BGP/genoscape_maps/shapefiles/ne_shapefiles/ne_10m_admin_0_boundary_lines_land.shp") %>%
  st_crop(domain)
states_cropped <- st_read("~/Dropbox/BGP/genoscape_maps/shapefiles/ne_shapefiles/ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces_lines.shp") %>%
  st_crop(domain)
lamproj <- "+proj=lcc +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-100 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=GRS80 +datum=NAD83 +units=m +no_defs"

#CRS_PLOT <- "+proj=aea +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-100 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
```
create outer shape from genoscape (LOSH shapefile)
```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
g <- rast("LOSH.genoscape_rgba.WGS84.tif")  
occ <- if (nlyr(g) >= 4) g[[4]] > 0 else !is.na(g[[1]])
occ <- classify(occ, cbind(0, NA))

aea <- "+proj=aea +lat_1=20 +lat_2=60 +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-100 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
rng <- st_as_sf(as.polygons(occ, dissolve = TRUE)) |> st_transform(aea)
# breeding samples, so every sampled site is inside
pts <- st_as_sf(br_meta, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(aea)

parts <- c(
  st_union(st_buffer(rng, 100000)),          # genoscape range + 100 km
  st_union(st_buffer(pts, 150000))           # 150 km around every breeding sample
  # , st_union(st_transform(st_read("ontario_polys.shp", quiet = TRUE), aea))  # optional
)
rng <- st_union(parts)

# merge pieces separated by < ~2*close_d, then shrink back
close_d <- 250000
rng <- st_buffer(st_buffer(rng, close_d), -close_d + 50000)

rng <- st_cast(rng, "POLYGON")
length(rng)                                   # want 1
rng <- rng[which.max(st_area(rng))]
rng <- st_sfc(lapply(rng, function(p) st_polygon(p[1])), crs = aea)   # exterior ring only
rng <- st_simplify(rng, dTolerance = 10000)                      # 10 km
rng <- st_transform(rng, 4326)

ring <- st_coordinates(rng)[, c("X", "Y")]
write.table(ring, "input/feems/LOSH_outer.txt", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
nrow(ring)   # a few hundred vertices is plenty
```
```{r}
br_meta<-read_delim("input/feems/LOSH.feems_meta.csv",delim=",") %>% filter(group=="breeding")
plot(st_geometry(rng), axes = TRUE)
points(br_meta$lon, br_meta$lat, pch = 20, col = "red", cex = 0.6)   # your breeding coordinates
```
Functions
```{r}
find_file <- function(name) {
  for (d in unique(c(run_dir, calib_dir))) {
    f <- file.path(d, name)
    if (file.exists(f)) return(f)
  }
  NA_character_
}
pick_col <- function(dt, choices) {
  hit <- intersect(choices, names(dt))
  if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
}
```

```{r}
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(data.table)

#name the directories
run_dir<-"output/feems/feems_LOSH_fst_outer_T251"
calib_dir<-"output/feems/feems_LOSH_fst_outer"

# ---- read assignment output --------------------------------------------------
f_long <- find_file("nonbreeding_assignment_long.csv")
f_summ <- find_file("nonbreeding_assignment_summary.csv")
if (is.na(f_long)) stop("nonbreeding_assignment_long.csv not found in ", run_dir)
long <- fread(f_long)
summ <- if (!is.na(f_summ)) fread(f_summ) else NULL
long[, deme := as.character(deme)]

T_used <- NA_real_
f_info <- find_file("run_info.json")
if (!is.na(f_info) && requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  info <- jsonlite::fromJSON(f_info)
  if (!is.null(info$temp)) T_used <- info$temp
}

ew <- fread("output/feems/feems_LOSH_fst_outer_T251/edge_weights.csv")
  a <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_as_sf(ew, coords = c("lon1", "lat1"), crs = 4326), lamproj))
  b <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_as_sf(ew, coords = c("lon2", "lat2"), crs = 4326), lamproj))
  ew[, c("x0", "y0", "x1", "y1") := .(a[, 1], a[, 2], b[, 1], b[, 2])]
  lim <- max(abs(ew$log10w_centered))

demes <- unique(long[, .(deme, deme_lon, deme_lat)])
deme_pts <- st_transform(st_as_sf(demes, coords = c("deme_lon", "deme_lat"), crs = 4326), lamproj)
xy <- st_coordinates(deme_pts)
nn <- apply(as.matrix(dist(xy)), 1, function(r) min(r[r > 0]))
spacing_m <- median(nn)
message(sprintf("[grid] median deme spacing %.0f km", spacing_m / 1000))

demes <- unique(long[, .(deme, deme_lon, deme_lat)])
samp_col <- pick_col(long, c("sampled", "is_sampled", "n_breeding", "n_samples", "n_breed"))
f_loo <- find_file("loo_validation.csv")
loo   <- if (!is.na(f_loo)) fread(f_loo) else NULL
if (!is.na(samp_col)) {
  s <- unique(long[, c("deme", samp_col), with = FALSE])
  demes[s, sampled := as.numeric(get(samp_col)) > 0, on = "deme"]
} else if (!is.null(loo)) {
  # every deme held out in leave-one-deme-out had breeding samples
  demes[, sampled := deme %in% as.character(loo$true_deme)]
} else {
  demes[, sampled := NA]
}
message(sprintf("[demes] %d demes, %s sampled", nrow(demes),
                ifelse(all(is.na(demes$sampled)), "unknown", sum(demes$sampled, na.rm = TRUE))))

# ---- spatial objects: deme cells (Voronoi, clipped) + basemap ---------------
xy <- st_coordinates(deme_pts)
nn <- apply(as.matrix(dist(xy)), 1, function(r) min(r[r > 0]))
spacing_m <- median(nn)
message(sprintf("[grid] median deme spacing %.0f km", spacing_m / 1000))

vor <- st_collection_extract(st_voronoi(st_union(deme_pts)), "POLYGON")
clip <- st_union(st_buffer(deme_pts, spacing_m * 0.6))
cells <- st_sf(geometry = st_intersection(st_sfc(vor, crs = lamproj), clip))
bbox <- st_bbox(st_buffer(st_union(deme_pts), spacing_m))
sampled_pts <- deme_pts[deme_pts$deme %in% demes[sampled == TRUE, deme], ]
  
gs <- rast("input/genoscape/LOSH.genoscape_rgba.WGS84.tif")              # or: rast(readRDS("LOSH_genoscape_brick.rds"))
#gs <- rast("LOSH.genoscape_rgba.AU4.WGS84.tif")              # or: rast(readRDS("LOSH_genoscape_brick.rds"))
if (nlyr(gs) == 4) {                          # use the alpha band to blank out-of-range pixels
  gs <- mask(gs[[1:3]], gs[[4]] > 0, maskvalues = FALSE)
}
gs <- project(gs, lamproj, method = "near")  # "near" keeps the cluster colours exact
gs <- crop(gs, ext(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"], bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"]))

genoscape_base <- function(alpha = 0.55) {
  ggplot() +
    # ggspatial::layer_spatial(hypso_cropped) +            # uncomment to add relief
    geom_spatraster_rgb(data = gs, r = 1, g = 2, b = 3,
                        alpha = alpha, max_col_value = 255) +
    geom_sf(data = coast_cropped,     fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = countries_cropped, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_sf(data = states_cropped,    fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1)
}

```

```{r}
finish_map <- function(g) {
  g + coord_sf(crs = lamproj, xlim = bbox[c("xmin", "xmax")], ylim = bbox[c("ymin", "ymax")],
               expand = FALSE) +
    theme(axis.title = element_blank())
}

p8 <- finish_map(
  genoscape_base() +
    geom_segment(data = ew, aes(x0, y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, colour = log10w_centered),
                 linewidth = 1, lineend = "round",alpha=0.8) +
    geom_sf(data = sampled_pts, shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 1.4) +
    scale_colour_gradient(low = "black", high = "grey85", limits = c(-lim, lim),
                          name = expression(log[10]~w~"(centred)")) +
    labs(title = "FEEMS migration surface over the LOSH genoscape"))
p8
```
```{r}
barrier_cut <- -0.4                                  # log10 w below the graph mean
barriers <- ew[log10w_centered < barrier_cut]
nrow(barriers)
p8b <- finish_map(
  genoscape_base() +
    geom_segment(data = barriers, aes(x0, y0, xend = x1, yend = y1),colour = "black",
                  alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1.2, lineend = "round") +
    geom_sf(data = sampled_pts, shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", size = 1.4) +
   # scale_colour_gradient(low = "black", high = "grey85", limits = c(-lim, lim),
    #                      name = expression(log[10]~w~"(centred)")) +
    labs(title = "FEEMS migration surface over the LOSH genoscape"))
p8b
```

Plot trajectory arrows
```{r}
traj
rectangled <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = coast_cropped, fill = NA, size = 0.2) +
  #ggspatial::layer_spatial(hypso_cropped) +
  geom_sf(data = countries_cropped, fill = NA, size = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = states_cropped, fill = NA, size = 0.1) +
  ggspatial::layer_spatial(genoscape_rgba) +
    # Arrows from winter → breeding, colored by Basin
  geom_curve(
    data = traj,
    aes(
      x = capture_lon, y = capture_lat,
      xend = map_lon, yend = map_lat,
      color = Assignment,
      alpha = map_prob
    ),
    curvature = 0.2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  
  # Points for winter captures (colored by Basin)
  geom_point(
    data = traj,
    aes(x = capture_lon, y = capture_lat, color = Assignment),
    size = 1,shape=17
  ) +
  
  # Points for predicted breeding locations (keep neutral green to distinguish)
  geom_point(
    data = traj,
    aes(x = map_lon, y = map_lat, color=Assignment),
    size = 1
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#009E73","#1874CD","#838B8B","#CD950C"))+
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-130, -60), ylim = c(10, 60),expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Winter to breeding origins using Fst",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    caption = "Arrows represent predicted breeding origin from Feems",
    color = "Assignment",
    alpha = "Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray85")
  )
```
